anomalies.description: Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight: one man (in tan tank top) is grabbed and thrown by the bald man (in white t-shirt), culminating in the first man being slammed onto a car hood.

The bald man pins the other man face-down on a car hood and applies sustained pressure to his head/neck area, while the victim is clearly incapacitated and screaming in pain—indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
The bald man slams the other man onto the car hood; the victim appears limp and unable to resist, indicating a helpless state during the assault.
A man is being forcibly restrained and pressed face-down onto a surface, with visible distress and physical pressure applied to his head/neck area.
The same victim remains under forceful restraint, with hands pressing down on his head and face, showing signs of suffocation or extreme duress.
A person is lying on their back, restrained or held down by another individual's hands on their neck/face area, with visible distress and facial contortion suggesting suffocation or strangulation.
